core.headline: Extended 1930s semi-detached house with garden office, Sevenoaks
core.summary: Extended 1930s semi-detached house with four bedrooms, loft conversion and modern kitchen/family room. South-west-facing garden with office, driveway parking, and within approx. 0.8 miles of Sevenoaks station.
core.listing:
This extended 1930s semi-detached house offers four bedrooms, three bathrooms and versatile family accommodation close to Sevenoaks station and Knole Park. The 2021 rear extension created a kitchen/family room measuring 7.80m x 5.10m max, with an island, bi-fold doors to the garden and underfloor heating. A loft conversion completed in 2019 with building regulations completion certificate provides a fourth bedroom measuring 5.20m x 3.30m max with en-suite shower room.

The ground floor comprises a sitting room measuring 4.55m x 3.70m into bay with log burner, a separate dining room measuring 3.60m x 3.40m, the kitchen/family room, utility room and shower room. The former garage was converted to create the utility and shower room. Original stained-glass features remain in the front door and hall window. On the first floor are three further bedrooms, including a principal bedroom measuring 4.20m x 3.60m, and a family bathroom.

Outside, the south-west-facing rear garden extends approx. 30m (100ft) and includes a paved patio and a garden office with power at the far end. A driveway provides parking for two cars.

Sevenoaks station is approx. 0.8 miles away, with trains to London Bridge taking approx. 25 minutes. Nearby are Sevenoaks School and Knole Park.

Guide Price £975,000. Freehold. Council Tax band F (Sevenoaks District Council). EPC rating D. Construction: Standard – Brick and render under a clay-tiled roof. Electricity, water and sewerage are mains; water is metered. Heating: Gas central heating; underfloor heating in kitchen/family room. Broadband: FTTP, up to 900Mbps. Mobile signal: Good indoor and outdoor coverage. Parking: Driveway for two cars. Planning: 2021 rear extension built with planning permission. Building safety, restrictions, rights & easements, flooding, coastal erosion, accessibility and coalfield/mining: None known.
